config_name: AQPG V17 Remediated Flan-T5 Fine-Tuning Configuration

v16_failure_remediations.control_blindness: 100% control tag coverage in prompts + 2,500 paired quadruplets varying 1 tag.
v16_failure_remediations.template_collapse: Dataset Top-10 stem concentration <= 6.50% + label smoothing 0.05 + early stopping.
v16_failure_remediations.question_type_mismatch: Stratified V17 type distribution (35% MCQ, 35% Num, 25% Conc, 5% Short) with exact eval monitoring.
v16_failure_remediations.numerical_failure: Numerical prompts balanced across Math (40%), Physics (40%), Chem (20%) with max_len=256.
v16_failure_remediations.memorization: Weight decay 0.01, max 3 epochs (~3,750 steps), and 0 train/val leakage.
v16_failure_remediations.subject_topic_accuracy: Explicit subject and topic tags in prompt string; subject-balanced curriculum.
